routines.role: Per-byte receive state machine driven by the serial interrupt. Phase [C6A0]: bit0=0 -> ignore; ==1 -> we are TRANSMITTING a packet: count down [C6A1/2], the last two bytes clocked in are the adapter acknowledgement bytes (stored at C6A9 = device id|$80, C6A8 = command^$80 or error $F0/$F1/$F2; error -> resend counters C6B9); ==3 -> we are RECEIVING a packet: stage [C6AB] 0=hunt magic ($99 then $66, $D2 = adapter idle), 1=4-byte header (length low byte kept in C6AC), 2=data, 3=checksum(2)+ack(2), 4=complete. Receive checksum accumulates in C6B2/C6B3 (16-bit big-endian sum), mismatch sets C6B4=1.
